caveat: Conservative undercount: only USDC settlements via facilitators we measure are counted. Operator-level (the full payout address), not pro-rata: do not sum across services that share a payout address. The daily series rolls up hourly, so the latest day can be up to about an hour behind, and briefly after a deploy the whole series can read low until the first rollup finishes (usually within minutes). Distinct buyers are counted per payout address, so a service with more than one payout address is an upper bound (a buyer paying two of its addresses on the same day counts once per address); a single-address service is exact.
